label: Petrarch
summary: Francesco Petrarca's lyric Canzoniere or his allegorical Trionfi.

claims.statement: Entered as no. 21 in the reconstructed catalogue of Leonardo's books, under Literature, Poetry and Fables. Leonardo's wording as rendered there: "Petrarch".
check_in: Leonardo's autograph book lists: Codex Trivulzianus f. 2r; Codex Atlanticus f. 559r; Madrid Codex II ff. 2v to 3r (which list names this title to be established)

claims.statement: Identified in the reconstruction as Canzoniere / Trionfi. The identification of a title in Leonardo's lists with a specific work and edition is an interpretation.
